title: French Sausage Tagine
description: A hearty French-inspired dish made with sausages and a flavorful tagine sauce. Perfect for a cold winter's night.

ingredients.name: Sausages
ingredients.notes: Use French sausages such as Toulouse or Kielbasa

ingredients.name: Tomato paste
ingredients.notes: Use high-quality paste for best flavor

ingredients.name: Chicken broth
ingredients.notes: Use low-sodium broth for best flavor

ingredients.name: Olive oil
ingredients.notes: Use good-quality oil for best flavor

ingredients.name: Chopped fresh parsley
ingredients.notes: Add just before serving for best flavor

instructions: Heat oil in the bottom of a large Dutch oven or heavy pot over medium-high heat.
Add sliced sausages and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Remove sausages from pot and set aside.
Add chopped onion to pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add tomato paste and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add diced tomatoes, chicken broth, and browned sausages.
Stir to combine and bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low and cook, covered, for 20-25 minutes or until sausages are cooked through.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Garnish with chopped parsley before serving.
